text.en: Clients consistently commend the trainers, particularly highlighting Yoni and John for their patient guidance and clear explanations. Pet owners appreciate that instructors take time to understand each dog's temperament and design realistic routines without harsh measures.

Reviewers report marked improvements in canine calmness, impulse control, and responsiveness following training courses. Owners describe dogs overcoming severe anxiety and reactivity, noting that practical household exercises delivered lasting behavioural changes.

Dog owners appreciate the force-free, food-motivated philosophy used throughout both individual sessions and residential board-and-train stays. Clients note that dogs are treated with genuine care, avoiding shock, choke, or prong collars during instruction.

q.en: What training methods are used at Balancing Paws?

a.en: Training relies on positive reinforcement and behavioural motivation, avoiding shock, choke, or chain collars during instruction.
Yes, clients frequently report using residential board-and-train stays, receiving regular progress updates and photo reports.

q.en: Can training assist dogs with severe anxiety or reactivity?

a.en: Several pet owners report significant progress in reducing reactivity around other dogs and managing grief or household anxiety.

q.en: Are group training classes available after foundational programmes?

a.en: Yes, group classes and follow-up lessons are available to reinforce skills acquired during foundational training courses.
